in_marathi.name: Deendyal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deendyal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deendyal means 'Heavenly' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'deen', which means 'heaven'. This name is often given to boys born into families who are believed to have a divine connection or who are destined for greatness.
